news.title: Connor McDavid extends his assist streak to 14 games as the Oilers beat the Islanders 4-0
news.ruTitle: Коннор Макдэвид продлил результативную серию до 14 игр, когда «Ойлерз» обыграли «Айлендерс» со счетом 4–0.
news.description: — Connor McDavid extended his NHL-record season-opening assist streak to 14 games by setting up Ryan Nugent-Hopkins' second goal, and the Edmonton Oilers opened their road trip by beating the New York Islanders 4-0 on Saturday.

news.title: Lindholm's overtime goal lifts the Bruins past the Blackhawks as Pastrnak moves past Bergeron
news.ruTitle: Гол Линдхольма в овертайме позволил "Брюинз" обойти "Блэкхокс", а Пастрняк обошел Бержерона
news.description: — Elias Lindholm scored in overtime as the Bruins rallied from a two-goal deficit in the third period to top the Chicago Blackhawks 5-4 and extend Boston’s home winning streak to five games.

news.title: Kaskimaki's first career NHL goal caps Blues' rally in 5-4 victory over Red Wings
news.ruTitle: Первый в карьере гол Каскимаки в НХЛ позволил "синим" одержать победу над "Ред Уингз" со счетом 5:4.
news.description: — Aleksanteri Kaskimaki scored his first career NHL goal to cap the St. Louis Blues' rally from a two-goal, third-period deficit in a 5-4 victory over the Detroit Red Wings on Saturday.

news.title: Islanders' Emil Heineman ejected for hit that injured Oilers' Isaac Howard
news.ruTitle: Игрок «Айлендерс» Эмиль Хейнеман катапультирован из-за удара, который травмировал игрока «Ойлерз» Исаака Ховарда
news.description: Islanders forward Emil Heineman was ejected early in Saturday's game against the Oilers for a knee-on-knee hit that injured Edmonton wing Isaac Howard.

news.title: Matt Pavelich, first linesman inducted into Hockey Hall of Fame, dies at 92
news.ruTitle: Мэтт Павелич, первый лайнсмен, введенный в Зал хоккейной славы, умер в возрасте 92 лет
news.description: The Hockey Hall of Fame announced Saturday that Matt Pavelich, the first linesman to be inducted into the Hall, had died at age 92.

news.title: Coach says Nikita Kucherov 'committed' to be with Lightning
news.ruTitle: Тренер говорит, что Никита Кучеров «принял решение» остаться с «Лайтнинг»
news.description: Tampa Bay coach Jon Cooper believes star winger Nikita Kucherov wants to remain a part of the Lightning this season despite news of his trade request Friday.

news.title: Flames beat Kraken 6-2 behind career-best 4 points from Matt Coronato
news.ruTitle: «Флэймз» обыграли «Кракена» со счетом 6–2, отстав от Мэтта Коронато, набравшего лучшие в карьере 4 очка.
news.description: — Matt Coronato had a career-high four points with a goal and three assists to lead the Calgary Flames over the Seattle Kraken 6-2 on Friday night.
